question.text: Let $a_{n}$ denote the number of all $n$-digit positive integers formed by the digits 0,1 or both such that no consecutive digits in them are 0 . Let $b_{n}=$ the number of such $n$-digit integers ending with digit 1 and $c_{n}=$ the number of such $n$-digit integers ending with digit 0 . Question: Which of the following is correct?

solution.text:
By recurring formula, $a_{17}=a_{16}+a_{15}$ is correct

Also $c_{17} \neq c_{16}+c_{15}$

$\Rightarrow a_{15} \neq a_{14}+a_{13}\left(\because c_{n}=a_{n-2}\right)$

$\therefore$ Incorrect

Similarly, other parts are also incorrect.
